findings.text: the survey's fleet surface names only cli/compute.py and cli/services.py as submission sites, but this file submits an Ollama SLURM job with sbatch and stops it at :2232 with scancel -n codex-llm-local 2>/dev/null, a name selector with discarded output, which is the same destructive-selection class section 3.1's Failure describes and is left unnamed.

the graph layer selects a SLURM job by name with squeue -n ... -u "$USER" | head -1 and cancels with scancel "$JOB_ID" 2>/dev/null || true, an unnamed submit/cancel path outside the placement ledger that section 3.1 claims to have listed.
a third SLURM placement site, the srun dispatch of the temporary Neo4j, is not named in section 3.1, so the three findings reported for that surface are not the whole set the census claims.

the manifest's tests line attributes the gate to revision 7e981e1ad but the log's first line names 0481ce82ee5828ec83391b337f0205c38bd5d921, and the final commit modified the surveyed file, so a reader who trusts the manifest is checking a revision the gate never measured.
